for months to get doctor appt. In the old days in the midlands and surrey, you pop in get seen same day. But now got to try endlessly on phone until get through. Not allowed to pop in or book online. Sure many like me need more care because problem not nipped in bud so to speak. I have given up officially now! My mum keeps saying go see doctor not understanding how impossible it is, because where i grew up, where she is, our doctor of many years will visit her, nurses call. Ive lived in 3 counties since left home, this has to be the worse for seeing a real human being whose profession is a doctor!

When i did finally get an actual appointment, was 2 weeks time in marchwood doctors, different place, had a car then so didnt mind but they cancelled it on the day. Then i got feedback request re appt with no option to say you cancelled it so i didnt see anyone!

Another time after 4 months trying to get appt. In desperation i went in, couldnt get appt, was told to phone. What would a person do if they've got no phone or cant phone because cant speak, lost their voice! Anyway finally got appt at hospital, did i see a doctor, no idea, he said go back to your doctor. I thought "but this is my doctor appointment!"

So this, long term unknown medical problem is in Gods hands.

The other simpler problem id been told i need antibiotics by pharmacists and chiropodist. This same person said quote "we wont give you antibiotics, we'll see if the black spreads up your leg"... In disbelief and shock i said nothing. No point going to a doctor. A few weeks later my toe nail fell off....  i still have the other issue nearly 2 years later.
(Elaras not my real
